text:
mara (marketing): Quick thread: we need a compact playbook for the upcoming benchmarks launch that sales can chew on. Three pieces: 1) hero claims we can defend, 2) SDR hooks + triage fields, 3) routing rules for inbound (plugs into Console).
leo (research): Hero claims I'd defend: 
- 'Lower median latency under realistic load patterns' (with methods footnote)
- 'Unit-cost improvements at 100k+ QPS-equivalent' (show ranges)
- 'Fallback policies to preserve availability during burst'
ishaan (product): Add technical signal: 'KV-cache warmup and continuous batching reduce p95 for long-context workloads' also call out quantized variants for cost-down fallback.
nina (growth): SDR hooks (two liners) and routing idea:
- "Saw you checked out our latency bench. is predictable p95 a blocker today?" -> route to sdr-bench
- "Interested in pilot pricing and dedicated pools?" -> route to ae-enterprise
Proposed triage fields: pain_point = latency|cost|compliance ; scale_estimate = dev|pilot|prod
omar (sales): Procurement rebut quicklines:
- "Reserved capacity + audit logs simplifies procurement for regulated teams."
- "We provide billing transparency: token-level cost breakdowns in the Console."
ops-bot: FYI: landing page scheduled 2025-09-10T14:00:00Z; A/B test live variant names: heroA/heroB set.
mara (marketing): Great. Nina, can you add UTMs and set the GA experiments? Also need two subject line options for the post-launch nurture: "Benchmarks: predictable inference, practical savings" and "How teams keep inference costs from ballooning"
leo (research): Also add one reproducibility snippet for the blog: a curl to the hosted API showing model and sequence parameters. Keep it brief.
ishaan (product): I'll provide a one-sentence tech explainer for the battlecard about fallback behavior that highlights 'no model replatforming' as a win vs some infra vendors.
mara (marketing): last item: keep legal phrasing soft. Avoid 'beats', use 'shows lower' or 'demonstrates'. Everyone cool with that?
omar (sales): cool. I'll finalize SDR snippets and drop them in Outreach by EOD.
nina (growth): setting up UTMs now. Will share tracking sheet in the drive.
mara (marketing): thanks team. closing thread unless someone needs more changes.
